thread:
emma_sales: FYI — Acme demo scheduled Tue 06/10 15:00 PT. They expect a short spike ~1.2k qps for ~10m. Can we provision a temporary hosted QPS uplift and an ephemeral/scoped key with IP allowlist for the window?

jordan_infra: Can you post the exact 15min window (start/end) and region? Need that to check capacity and whether Dedicated fallback is required.

emma_sales: Window is 15:00-15:12 PT (UTC-7). Region: us-west-2. Scoped key should only be valid for 20m.

sam_ops: We can do a temporary quota bump for a short burst. Process: create a support ticket with the scoped key and window, ops will flip the limit. Also please include expected model & avg seq len.

mia_security: Per security, ephemeral key TTL <= 30m is fine; prefer 15m. Must include IP allowlist (CIDR) and enable audit logs. We also need confirmation that no PII will be in prompts.

emma_sales: Sent to Acme: they will use gpt-open-2 (approx 1.4k token/sec equivalent), seq len ~512, no PII. IPs: 203.0.113.0/28 and 198.51.100.128/25.

alex_engineering: FYI if we run close to capacity we can route to a cheaper quantized variant automatically as fallback. If ops agrees, we can pre-config a fallback policy for the window.

sam_ops: @alex_engineering +1 on fallback. ops needs the ephemeral key string in ticket — PLEASE DO NOT POST KEYS PUBLICLY here. You can paste a sample request payload instead.

emma_sales: Understood. Creating ticket and attaching the ephemeral key in the ticket. Ticket will include: window, region, model, seq len, IP CIDRs, TTL=20m, requester contact.

alex_engineering: Sample ephemeral key creation snippet (for internal use):
```
POST /v1/keys
{
  "name": "acme-demo-ephemeral",
  "scopes": ["text.generate"],
  "ttl_seconds": 1200,
  "allowed_ips": ["203.0.113.0/28","198.51.100.128/25"]
}
```

mia_security: Also request: enable token revocation after window and forward audit logs to Acme's SIEM via syslog endpoint if they asked. Confirmed no PII per legal.

deploy-bot: New support ticket created: #SUP-8762 — temporary qps bump request (owner: sam_ops).

sam_ops: I'll triage #SUP-8762 now. If capacity check passes, ops can raise hosted QPS to 1500 for the 12m window and attach the scoped key. Will post when done.

emma_sales: Thanks all — please @mention me on ticket updates. I'll coordinate with Acme for live handoff on demo day. :thumbsup:
